resources.string: Used only for the Remove all blocks option
Uses the master password to delete all configured blocks and limits
Enter the master password to remove all blocks. This password does not unlock individual apps or websites.
This setting cannot be changed while FocusGuard is enforcing any block. To end all protection, use Remove all blocks in Settings and confirm with the master password.
FocusGuard cannot be uninstalled while protection is active. First use Remove all blocks in Settings; the master password is requested only for that action.
Available without a password when no blocks are active
